A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same paper with complete main text, references, and Appendices A–K. Text extraction and rendered-page comparisons support reliable comparison of their methods, equations, figures, tables, and results.

before.justification: v7 reports original LLM forgetting measurements, forgetting-prediction and replay experiments (Table 3 and Figure 5), and supplementary experiments including Rotated-MNIST in Appendix K.

after.justification: v8 retains the original LLM forgetting, prediction, and replay results, together with the empirical analyses and Rotated-MNIST experiments in the appendices.

M1.justification: The low-rank formulations, additive/MF/KNN prediction procedures, and online/offline targeted replay algorithms are unchanged. The combined embedding and matrix-completion method in Appendix I is also identical.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage is identical, including the upstream corpora and fine-tuning tasks in Table 1, downstream leaderboard evaluations, UltraFeedback perturbations, and Rotated-MNIST experiments. The task lists in Tables 15–16 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains the SBERT and Text-Embedding-3 comparators. Replay comparisons retain Rand, PPL, MIR-T, and Grad-Prod for OLMo-1B. Comparator membership in the appendix experiments is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Task splits, the 30 upstream examples with known forgetting, the held-out 10,000-example replay evaluation, metrics, and training settings are unchanged. Appendices C–K retain the same experimental protocols.

E4.justification: The rank-sensitivity study, training-setting and replay analyses, combined-prediction experiment, noisy/adversarial data tests, and synthetic experiments are retained unchanged (Table 6 and Appendices G–K).

E5.justification: Table 3 still averages over 10 randomly sampled sets of examples with known forgetting; Appendix C still states that forgetting statistics were collected in a single run. Figure 5's paired t-tests and the appendix statistical procedures are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical tables, plotted results, and reported findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains 58.16 F1 for in-domain MF prediction on OLMo-7B-Instruct. The appendix results also match; page 23 changes only a footnote number.

T1.justification: Definitions of forgetting and association matrices, low-rank/logistic factorization objectives, and first-order gradient approximations are identical in Sections 2–3 and Appendix E. No mathematical reasoning or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about low-rank forgetting associations, matrix-completion prediction, and reduced forgetting through targeted replay. The new resource footnote does not change the scientific contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications remain unchanged, including Appendix F's limited downstream replay benefits and Appendix A's limitations concerning sequential learning, theoretical guarantees, experimental scope, and upstream-data access.

D1.justification: v8 adds a page 1 footnote linking the authors' low-rank-forgetting repository for code, data, and collected statistics. v7 lacks this project-resource pointer. This adds access documentation; the implementation details and hyperparameters remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction, Section 5, and bibliography retain the same cited works and research positioning. The prior-work passage shifted from page 1 to page 2 is unchanged.

P1.justification: v8 adds a brief resource footnote, updates the arXiv version/date stamp, and adjusts footnote numbering. The existing prose, section order, and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The new page 1 footnote pushes two introduction lines onto page 2, slightly changing its spacing. The existing page 23 footnote is renumbered from 1 to 2. Figures, tables, captions, and all other page renderings are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new repository pointer modestly improves resource discoverability and reproducibility documentation compared with v7. Scientific content and appendix evidence remain unchanged, with no substantive deterioration identified. The PDFs establish the added access information, but do not establish the linked resources' completeness or usability.
